derivation:
by
  simpa only [xCoord, dotProduct] using
    (continuous_subtype_val : Continuous (Subtype.val : Realization p → _)).dotProduct (continuous_const (y := fun c : BarredPermutation p => (c.blockIndex i : ℝ)))
explanation: After unfolding xCoord, this is continuity of the dot product of the subtype's weight vector with the constant vector of block indices. Continuous.dotProduct supplies this result independently.
